events.verdict: Bazemore (ATL) makes contact with Walker's (CHA) body after the ball has been dislodged at the end of his drive. The contact is deemed incidental.
Young (ATL) rests a hand on Walker's (CHA) body as he cleanly dislodges the ball during his drive.
Bazemore (ATL) initiates contact with Walker's (CHA) arm and affects his ability to regain possession of the ball.
Zeller (CHA) is in the path of Collins (ATL) but clamps his arm during the screen and affects his ability to defend.
Prince (ATL) does not step into Williams' (CHA) landing area on his jump shot attempt.
Bazemore (ATL) makes contact with Zeller's (CHA) arm and affects his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Lamb (CHA) puts two hands to the front of Young's (ATL) body during his dribble but does not affect his SQBR as Young exaggerates the contact.
Zeller (CHA) is in the path of Bembry (ATL) and does not deliver contact.
Collins (ATL) moves laterally into Walker's (CHA) path and affects his SQBR.
Lamb (CHA) does not step into Young's (ATL) landing area on his jump shot attempt.
Prince (ATL) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Walker (CHA) initiates marginal contact with Collins' (ATL) leg and does not affect his ability to defend the shot.
Collins (ATL) is in the path of Lamb (CHA) but any contact is incidental.
Bembry (ATL) brings one hand to the opposite side of Lamb's (CHA) body but removes it as he moves away.
Bazemore (ATL) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Bembry (ATL) puts a hand to Walker's (CHA) front at the start of his drive, but he is able to move through the marginal contact and maintain possession of the ball.
RHH shows Collins (ATL) moves into Walker's (CHA) path at the end of his drive and initiates leg to leg contact that affects his SQBR.
Correctly called 24 Second Violation.
Walker (CHA) intentionally fouls Young (ATL).
[Observable in enhanced video] Bazemore (ATL) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Bacon (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position on Bazemore's (ATL) shot.

Collins (ATL) cleanly blocks the shot and makes contact with Walker's (CHA) arm during the follow-through on his driving shot attempt but does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
